title: Medical check for a firearm permit
also: medical check for a gun license
what: A medical check that is required to get or renew a firearm permit. It usually includes several doctors and a lab test.
why: When getting or renewing a firearm license.
duration: usually 1 to 2 days, the lab result in a few days
tell_doctor: Diseases of the nervous system and mental health

prepare.title: List of doctors
prepare.text: Usually you need a general doctor or occupational doctor, an eye doctor, a psychiatrist and an addiction specialist. Ask the clinic for the exact list.

prepare.title: Lab test
prepare.text: A urine test for drugs and strong substances is often needed. Tell the doctor about all your medicines.

prepare.title: The day before
prepare.text: Do not drink alcohol. Do not stop medicines on your own.

bring: Glasses or lenses, if you wear them
A photo, if the clinic requires it
steps: You come to a clinic that issues this certificate
An eye doctor checks your vision
A psychiatrist asks questions and sometimes gives tests
You give a urine sample for testing
A general doctor or occupational doctor completes the report
feel: The talk with the psychiatrist is made of ordinary questions - there is no need to worry
after: The certificate is issued after all the exams and the test
Find out how long the certificate is valid and submit your papers on time

faq.q: Can I see the psychiatrist and addiction specialist at any clinic?
faq.a: Usually you need a clinic that is allowed to issue these reports. Ask in advance.
Some can. Be sure to tell the doctor what you take.

reminders.text: Firearm medical check tomorrow. Do not drink alcohol, and take your ID and glasses if you wear them.
